title: Four to one, from anywhere
hook: Start with all A or all B. Does the reaction remember where it began?

doesNotKnow: that the equilibrium constant K fixes the split, whatever the starting point

misconception: A reaction goes to completion, or K = 4 means 4 molecules react.
objective: The learner can explain that for A ⇌ B with K = [B]/[A] = 4, 100 molecules settle near 80 B and 20 A from any start, because at that split the forward and backward rates are equal.

claims.text: For A ⇌ B with K = [B]/[A] = 4 and 100 molecules, the settled mix is about 80 B and 20 A (80 ÷ 20 = 4).
claims.source: B/A = 4 with A + B = 100 gives A = 20, B = 80. Equilibrium constant definition (IUPAC Gold Book, 'equilibrium constant'). Demo.tsx B_EQ.

claims.text: Every start settles near 80 B; the count wobbles by a few because each run is chance with only 100 molecules.
claims.source: Simulation: per step, A -> B with p = 0.20 and B -> A with p = 0.05 (ratio 4); gap to equilibrium shrinks by 0.75 per step. Seeds 1 (all A), 2 (all B), 3 (half) are untuned (first tried): at steps 10-60 they read 79 77 82 86 74 80 / 85 78 73 84 83 88 / 85 79 76 86 71 82. Over seeds 1-500 at step 20, from all A or all B: median 80, 95% range 72 to 87-88 (node). Binomial(100, 0.8) sd = 4. · Fact-check 2026-10-13: Reproduced: seeds 1/2/3 and the 500-seed range (median 80, 72-87) match.

claims.text: At equilibrium both reactions keep going at equal rates: 20% of 20 A and 5% of 80 B, 4 each way per step.
claims.source: 0.20 x 20 = 4 = 0.05 x 80 (dynamic equilibrium; Atkins & Jones, Chemical Principles, ch. on equilibrium). The per-step chances are the toy's, chosen so their ratio is K.

claims.text: K fixes where the mix ends up, not where it began; changing the temperature changes K.
claims.source: Equilibrium composition is independent of the starting direction for a given K; K depends on temperature (van 't Hoff equation; Atkins & de Paula, Physical Chemistry, ch. on chemical equilibrium).

recall.question: For A ⇌ B, K = [B]/[A] = 1. You start with 60 B and no A. The settled mix holds about…
recall.why: K = 1 means equal amounts at equilibrium, whatever the start: 60 molecules split 30 and 30.
